name: cssGraphics
tagline: A DOM-ready 3D asset library powered by PolyCSS
description: cssGraphics packages animated and interactive 3D models as real HTML and CSS, without a WebGL or canvas renderer, powered by the PolyCSS engine. It ships original generative scenes like 3D Pipes, an XScreenSaver-inspired scene using prepared connected tube meshes, plus faithful source-backed ports of classic screensavers: Flower Box with 1,200 stable retained triangle leaves, and Gears with prepared three-gear assemblies. The browser retains prepared DOM and does not build geometry, lighting, or camera state at runtime, keeping scenes stable and fast. Each adapter is self-contained with its own build and dev commands, and third-party models retain their original licenses with attribution listed in the catalog.
highlights: Real 3D scenes rendered as HTML and CSS — no WebGL or canvas
Original 3D Pipes scene plus faithful ports of Flower Box and Gears
Retained DOM with prepared geometry, lighting, and camera — nothing built at runtime
Self-contained adapters, each with its own build and dev commands
The library behind the viral 3D CSS Super Mario demo
curatorNote: The library behind the viral 3D CSS Super Mario demo — pure-CSS 3D assets for the DOM, brand new at 24 stars. It is a reminder that the browser's rendering engine is still an under-explored creative canvas.
